arguments.reason: A rule cannot read the fraud labels, because the labels are what it is scored against. The condition "id IN (SELECT transaction_id FROM fraud_labels WHERE is_fraud = 1)" uses them directly, so I can't turn it into a rule. If you tell me the transaction characteristics you think separate fraud, such as amount, transaction type, merchant category, or card attributes, I can propose a rule built from those and measure it against the labels.
